# Standing motion capture

Sam Lazarus recorded the standing performance with Rokoko motion capture equipment. The source file is `Regular_Light_mixamo.fbx` from the IdlesMocapPack_noFACE folder of [Rokoko's 263-asset collection](https://www.rokoko.com/resources/download-263-rokoko-motion-capture-assets). Rokoko permits use in games, including commercial projects. [Everyday idle recordings and usage terms](https://www.rokoko.com/resources/rokoko-mocap-10-free-everyday-idle-animations).

The duel uses a loop of the recorded torso, shoulder and head motion fitted to the archers' standing pose. Rebuild the character clips with **Bow Man VR > Characters > Bake standing idle** in Unity.

## Bow action recording

`Hawkeye_Archery_mixamo.fbx` comes from the Superhero folder in the same free collection. The full take contains several gestures. The straight draw around 5–7 seconds is the candidate for the visible opponent's bow action. Game timing, equipment contact and left-handed playback still need fitting. [Rokoko's motion collection](https://www.rokoko.com/resources/download-263-rokoko-motion-capture-assets)
